name: D1Bound5.finiteP_residual_norm_lt
original_signature:
(a b s c : ℂ)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖a‖) (hAB : ‖a‖ ≤ ‖b‖) (hBS : ‖b‖ ≤ ‖s‖)
    (hAC : 1000 ≤ ‖a‖*‖c‖) (i : Fin 4) :
    ‖finitePResidual a b s c i‖ < 3*‖s‖^2/(‖a‖^3*‖c‖^5)
explicit_arguments: a b s c hA hAB hBS hAC i

name: D1Bound5.finitePRowForm_eq_root_sum
original_signature:
(a b s c z rA rB rS : ℂ) (i : Fin 4) :
    finitePRowForm a b s c z rA rB rS i =
      finitePDividedMatrix a b s c i 0*z+
        ∑ j : Fin 3, finitePRootColumn a b s c i j*![rA,rB,rS] j
explicit_arguments: a b s c z rA rB rS i

name: D1Bound5.finitePRowForm_norm_lt
explicit_arguments: a b s c z rA rB rS ha hb hs hz hA hAB hBS hC hAC herr i

name: D1Bound5.full_ring_finiteP_inequality
original_signature:
{K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {S : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hS : IsD1 S) (a : Fin 3 → 𝓞 K) (c d : 𝓞 K)
    (haS : ∀ j, a j ∈ S) (hcS : c ∈ S) (hdS : d ∈ S)
    (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hac : ∀ j, a j ≠ c)
    (had : ∀ j, a j ≠ d) (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (hmon : Monotone (fun j => ‖phi (a j : K)‖))
    (hCT : 200*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (c : K)‖)
    (hCD : ‖phi (c : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (d : K)‖)
    (hAC : 1000 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (c : K)‖) :
    ∃ z : 𝓞 K, z^2 = c*d+1 ∧
      1 < 2400*max (‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^3)
          (‖phi (a 1 : K)‖^3*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2)*‖phi (c : K)‖^3/‖phi (z : K)‖+
        3*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2*‖phi (z : K)‖/
          (‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^3*‖phi (c : K)‖^5)
explicit_arguments: hK phi hS a c d haS hcS hdS hinj hac had hcd hmon hCT hCD hAC

name: D1Bound5.full_ring_finiteP_closed_interval_excluded
original_signature:
{K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {S : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hS : IsD1 S) (a : Fin 3 → 𝓞 K) (c d : 𝓞 K)
    (haS : ∀ j, a j ∈ S) (hcS : c ∈ S) (hdS : d ∈ S)
    (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hac : ∀ j, a j ≠ c)
    (had : ∀ j, a j ≠ d) (hcd : c ≠ d)
    (hmon : Monotone (fun j => ‖phi (a j : K)‖))
    (hCT : 200*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (c : K)‖)
    (hCD : ‖phi (c : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (d : K)‖)
    (hAC : 1000 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (c : K)‖)
    (hleft : 4*(2400 : ℝ)^2*
      (max (‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^3)
        (‖phi (a 1 : K)‖^3*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2))^2*
      ‖phi (c : K)‖^5/(1-1/4000 : ℝ) ≤ ‖phi (d : K)‖)
    (hright : ‖phi (d : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^6*‖phi (c : K)‖^9/
      (36*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^4*(1+1/4000 : ℝ))) : False
explicit_arguments: hK phi hS a c d haS hcS hdS hinj hac had hcd hmon hCT hCD hAC hleft hright
